title: The Microwave Was Invented by a Melted Chocolate Bar 🍫 #shorts
description:
In 1945 radar engineer Percy Spencer stood next to a running magnetron and, as the story goes, the chocolate bar in his pocket melted. So he tried popcorn: it popped all over the lab. Then an egg: it exploded in a coworker's face. The first microwave oven weighed 750 pounds. His bonus for the patent? Two dollars.

Believe It Or Bear: true stories, twist endings. Follow for more.
